title: Goal with target 0 renders 'Infinity% (≈0 shifts)' in the sheet preview, then vanishes on reload
detail: `addGoal` (4683-4684) requires `t>0`, but `updGoalTarget` (4686) accepts whatever NumInput commits, and NumInput (4016-4027) commits `min` (=0, per the goal row at 4757) on an emptied field. The sheet's goal line (4248) is guarded only by `previewNet>0`, not `g.target>0`, so `previewNet/0` → Infinity and `Math.ceil(0/previewNet)` → 0. On the next load `sanitizeData` (goals branch, 1071-1082) drops any goal with target ≤ 0, so the goal silently disappears.
failure: Settings → Savings goals → clear the amount field of 'Car' (blur commits 0). Open any day: the preview reads 'toward your goal: Car Infinity% (≈0 shifts)'. Reopen the app later: the 'Car' goal is gone with no message.
fix: In the sheet, `goals.filter(g=>g.target>0).slice(0,3)` before mapping (and hide the line if none remain). In Settings, have `updGoalTarget` keep the previous target when `parseFloat(v)` is not > 0, or give that NumInput `min={1}`, so a goal can never be saved into the state that the loader deletes.
